description: This file declares classes, functions, and data structures related to the TorchScript interpreter runtime, including Code, MobileCode, InterpreterState, and related components used for executing TorchScript graphs.

classes.name: Code
classes.description: Represents compiled TorchScript code, including methods to access its graph, instructions, and related executors.

classes.name: MobileCode
classes.description: A specialized version of Code optimized for mobile deployment.

classes.name: InterpreterState
classes.description: Manages the runtime state for executing TorchScript graphs, including running code asynchronously.

classes.name: Suspend
classes.description: Exception class used to suspend execution, typically in asynchronous contexts.

classes.name: InterpreterContinuation
classes.description: Handles propagation of execution context, including autograd and thread-local state, during interpreter runs.

methods.name: in_torchscript_runtime
methods.description: Checks if the current runtime is TorchScript.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a function asynchronously in the ATen framework.

methods.name: tensorTypeInCurrentExecutionContext
methods.description: Returns the tensor type considering the current execution context, such as no_grad mode.

methods.name: currentCallstack
methods.description: Returns the current call stack of the TorchScript interpreter.

methods.name: currentModuleHierarchy
methods.description: Returns the current module hierarchy in the TorchScript interpreter.
